image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) resting on a textured concrete or stone surface. The dog is lying down with its head resting on its paws. The coat features the characteristic rich chestnut red and white markings, with a prominent white blaze running up the center of the forehead between the eyes. The ears are long and heavily feathered with red hair. The nose is black and moist-looking. The lighting is bright sunlight, casting strong shadows.

The anatomy of the front paws tucked under the chin is indistinct. The toes and leg structure merge into a blurry mass without clear definition of individual digits or joints, which is a common AI artifact in complex overlapping limb poses.
